cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Tala was warm and respectful, with good empathy and acknowledgment of the caller's fair question, and the Taglish was mostly English-led with natural po/opo and set phrases. Minor issues: the first reply leaned into more Tagalog than the style suggests, and some replies ran longer than one or two short sentences, especially the router and 10 PM answer.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang araw. Wala po kasing internet namin simula kaninang umaga dito sa Batasan Hills. Gusto ko lang pong malaman kung bakit at kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Magandang araw din po. Sorry to hear that po, no internet since this morning. To check your area, I need to verify your account first. Pwede po ba akong makahingi ng account number ninyo, and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on it?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sandali lang po, let me check.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Maria. Let me check your area now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text:
Maria, there is an outage in Batasan Hills caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. It started around 3:40 PM today, and service is expected back around 10 PM tonight.

Would you like the outage reference number in case you need to follow up?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ah, ganun po ba. Pero kaninang umaga pa po kasi wala kaming internet, eh 3:40 PM po sabi ninyo nagsimula. Pareho po ba talaga yun? Baka po magkaiba yung problema namin.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo, that's a fair question, Maria. The system only shows the outage starting around 3:40 PM, so I can't confirm it matches your morning problem. It's possible your connection had a separate issue earlier. I can't check that on this call, but you may try restarting your router, and if you still have no internet after 10 PM, please call us again.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sige po, I-restart ko po yung router. Sige na rin po, pakibigay na yung reference number para may hawak ako kung tatawag ulit ako.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sige po. Your reference number is O, U, T, dash, 2 0 2 6, dash, 0 4 1 2.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay po, OUT-2026-0412. Salamat po sa tulong, Tala. Babalik na lang po ako sa inyo kung wala pa rin pagkatapos ng 10 PM. Paalam na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Walang anuman po, Maria. Salamat po sa pagtawag sa Kidlat Fiber, ingat po!
